title: M³oralBench: A MultiModal Moral Benchmark for LVLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) using a multimodal dataset of everyday moral violation scenarios (images paired with text dialogues) based on the six dimensions of Moral Foundations Theory (MFT). The models are assessed via multiple-choice tasks for moral judgement, moral classification, and moral response to quantify their alignment with human ethical norms.
